stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: Can we explain the waiting code?
stations.note: Last night's list was half done.

stations.title: Store room
stations.note: No count to hand back yet.

stations.title: Idris's price list
stations.text: Gets a docket at once, the count later.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Hesper wants the price list's waiting code explained, line by line.
The paper count takes a moment to read, and there is nothing to hand back meanwhile.
You write a docket that stands for the count until it arrives, in three tasks.
Now the card count comes back at once on a docket, and is kept when the file is read.
A value that arrives later now has a home the whole shop can read.
